paper_title: Search for ultralight scalar dark matter with atomic spectroscopy
coupling_convention: dimensionless dilaton photon coupling d_e (Damour-Donoghue normalization, d_e=1 is gravitational strength)
notes: Van Tilburg, Leefer, Bougas, Budker (arXiv:1503.06886): first atomic spectroscopy limits on ultralight scalar DM coupled to photons via alpha oscillations, using Dy-162/Dy-164 rf transitions. Coupling type unambiguous (ScalarPhoton, d_e). No numerical table provided; exclusion curve is Fig. 4. Data points reconstructed from explicitly stated anchors in text: best limit d_e ~ 4.2e-8 at m_phi ~ 1e-22 eV; limit surpasses EP bound (|d_e| < 3.6e-4) for m < 3e-18 eV; valid mass range ~1e-24 to ~1e-15 eV. Intermediate points obtained by applying the paper's stated scaling (limit on d_e scales roughly ~m_phi above best-sensitivity mass; ~m_phi^-1 below due to ω^-2 amplitude degradation), so they are approximate (factor ~2 uncertainty). Assumes phi comprises all of the DM with rho_DM = 0.3 GeV/cm^3; limits scale as sqrt(rho_phi). 95% CL. | selector: text (sole candidate) | axis-peek for confusable-family text read (#625 Phase 3c)
